kpis.signal: KPI maitre fintech, croissance composee +52%/an 5 ans, base monetisation cross-sell
kpis.description_fr: Membres SoFi (utilisateurs cumules ayant adopte au moins 1 produit). Croissance >50%/an post-IPO, base de la 'Financial Services Productivity Loop' strategy. 10.1M fin 2024.
kpis.description_en: SoFi members (cumulative users with at least 1 product). >50%/yr post-IPO growth, base of 'Financial Services Productivity Loop' strategy. 10.1M end 2024.

kpis.signal: Plus gros segment, contribution profit 890 M$ (60% marge), porte par hausse net interest income
kpis.description_fr: CA segment Lending (personal loans, student loans, home loans + Loan Platform Business). Contribution profit 890.5 M$ FY24 (+8% YoY), marge 60%. Hero segment SoFi.
kpis.description_en: Lending segment revenue (personal, student, home loans + Loan Platform Business). FY24 contribution profit $890.5M (+8% YoY), 60% margin. SoFi hero segment.

kpis.signal: Hypercroissance +88% YoY, bascule contribution profit positive (307 M$ vs -262 K$ FY23)
kpis.description_fr: CA Financial Services (SoFi Money, Invest, Credit Card, Relay, Insurance, Protect). Hypercroissance +88% FY24, bascule contribution positive 307 M$. Cle de la diversification.
kpis.description_en: Financial Services revenue (SoFi Money, Invest, Credit Card, Relay, Insurance, Protect). FY24 hypergrowth +88%, contribution flip to positive $307M. Diversification key.

kpis.signal: Galileo + Technisys, 168M comptes (+15% YoY) actives, croissance soutenue malgre maturite
kpis.description_fr: CA Tech Platform (Galileo BaaS + Technisys core banking). 168M comptes actives fin 2024 (vs 145M FY23, +15%). Croissance LatAm + consumer brands US. Contribution profit 127 M$ (+34%).
kpis.description_en: Tech Platform revenue (Galileo BaaS + Technisys core banking). 168M enabled accounts end 2024 (vs 145M FY23, +15%). LatAm + US consumer brands growth. Contribution $127M (+34%).

kpis.signal: Funding cout 4.0% vs taux marche 5%+, 98% assures FDIC, leverage charter bancaire
kpis.description_fr: Depots totaux SoFi Bank (post charter bancaire fev 2022). 98% assures FDIC. Avantage cout funding (4.0% vs marche 5%+) cle de la marge nette d'interet.
kpis.description_en: SoFi Bank total deposits (post Feb 2022 banking charter). 98% FDIC insured. Funding cost advantage (4.0% vs market 5%+), key to net interest margin.

kpis.signal: 1.46 produits par membre, cross-sell ratio en hausse, valide Productivity Loop
kpis.description_fr: Produits totaux (somme lending + financial services + tech platform). Ratio 1.46 produits/membre. Valide la 'Financial Services Productivity Loop' (cross-sell intra-platforme).
kpis.description_en: Total products (sum of lending + financial services + tech platform). 1.46 products/member ratio. Validates 'Financial Services Productivity Loop' (cross-sell intra-platform).

kpis_story.description_fr: FY24 = premier exercice GAAP profitable historique SoFi (net income $499M après pertes cumulées >$3Md). Pivot stratégique vers durabilité financière confirmé. Cible $5-6B revenue 2026.
kpis_story.description_en: FY24 = SoFi first historical GAAP profitable year ($499M net income after >$3Bn cumulative losses). Confirmed strategic pivot to financial sustainability. $5-6B revenue 2026 target.

_notes: Digital bank. Source: 10-K FY24 filed Feb 2025.
